name: Labcorp
import_label: Choose Apple Health ZIP or Labcorp PDFs…
manual_export_steps: Preferred for structured history: on iPhone, open Health, tap your profile picture, choose Health Records, add Labcorp, and sign in with your Labcorp Patient account. After the records finish downloading, use Health → profile → Export All Health Data and import that ZIP here.
For report files: sign in to Labcorp Patient or MyLabcorp, open Results, view a result, and download the official report. Repeat for the reports you want, then select those PDFs here.
Labcorp says its current MyLabcorp app can show historical results going back about 15 years; confirm the desired history is visible before downloading or exporting.
registration_note: Labcorp supports Health Records on iPhone, which uses patient-facing FHIR APIs, but Labcorp does not publish third-party public-client registration and endpoint documentation for a local app. Direct connection remains disabled until Labcorp provides and permits those details.
direct_note: Labcorp has a patient-facing FHIR path through Apple Health, but Clippi-Health still needs Labcorp's endpoint and third-party public-client registration. Use Apple Health or PDF import now.
